notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve released a small update. Now the Window Mode is available. :)


February is a special month for us. The game "Cats Everywhere" is celebrating 1 year anniversary!
And to celebrate, we’ve released an anniversary update! 

Check it out!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2249850/Cats_Everywhere/]Cats Everywhere[/url]


Hope you enjoy it!
